summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K containing a batch of share buyback transaction notices, each for 20,000 ordinary shares purchased on the London Stock Exchange via Goldman Sachs International, all part of a pre-announced buyback program and a standing authority. The purchases are routine open-market repurchases—not an issuer tender offer—with shares to be cancelled. No special-situation event (e.g., transformation, tender, or strategic change) is involved. The filing is a regular current report of foreign private issuer, reporting ordinary-course capital return activity without any structural change.
